I haven't edited any source files and haven't committed anything. Below is the baseline and the Slice 7 plan for your approval.

## Baseline (before any changes)

- **Tests:** `npm test` passes, 89/89 across 6 files (bills, cashForecast, cashForecastAnchor, appState, alerts, whatIfForecast).
- **Build:** `npm run build` succeeds with no TypeScript errors. It writes to `dist/`.
- **Branch:** `master`, HEAD at `64a8ce4 feat: complete slice 06 bills management and demo reset`.
- **Working tree is not clean.** `package.json` has an uncommitted `@playwright/test` devDependency, and `package-lock.json` is modified too. I left both alone. Tell me whether they belong in Slice 7 or should be kept out of the commit.

## What Slice 06 touched

- `src/utils/bills.ts`: `validateBillInput`, `nextDueDate`, `createBill`, `payBill`. Recurrence and payment logic.
- `src/state/AppState.tsx`: reducer, `nextBillId`, `generatePaymentId`, provider and context. Holds `bills`, `billPayments`, `cashAccounts`, `invoices`, `payments`, `resetCount`.
- `src/types.ts`, `src/screens/Bills.tsx`, `src/screens/Overview.tsx`.

## Findings that shape the plan

- `formatINR` in `src/utils/format.ts` is a hand-written formatter, not `Intl.NumberFormat`. It already produces Indian grouping. I'll swap its body for `Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", …)` and keep the export name and signature, so every caller keeps working. `alerts.ts` messages call it too.
- Tables are in `Overview.tsx`, `Invoices.tsx` (two tables), `CashForecast.tsx`.
- Dates go through `formatDate` (en-IN, "15 Jun 2025"). It stays as is, with `tabular-nums` added where dates are rendered.

## Files I intend to change

**Formatting (logic-neutral)**
- `src/utils/format.ts`: `formatINR` body → `Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR", maximumFractionDigits: 0 })`. Negatives keep the leading minus (`-₹4,500`). `formatDate` and the day-math helpers are unchanged.
- `src/utils/format.test.ts` (new): covers ₹1,25,000, ₹12,50,000, negatives, and zero.

**Styling (classes only)**
- `src/index.css`: alabaster canvas, white surfaces, 1px neutral hairline tokens, one accent color.
- `src/components/StatCard.tsx`, `src/components/StatusBadge.tsx`: remove pill shape and tinted fills; plain text status marks.
- `src/components/Sidebar.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`: single accent, flat active state, canvas background.
- `src/components/AlertsPanel.tsx`, `src/components/ForecastChart.tsx`, `src/components/ReminderDrawer.tsx`, `src/components/WhatIfSimulator.tsx`: `tabular-nums` on figures and dates, remove decorative gradients.
- `src/screens/Overview.tsx`, `src/screens/Invoices.tsx`, `src/screens/CashForecast.tsx`, `src/screens/Bills.tsx`, `src/screens/Placeholder.tsx`: right-align amount columns, left-align text and dates, add row hover states, `tabular-nums` on ₹ and date cells.

**Sample data (names and labels only)**
- `src/data/seed.ts`: Indian client names, studio rent, software bills, milestone retainer descriptions. IDs, amounts, dates and relationships stay the same, so the financial calculations and payment history are unchanged.

**Not touched:** `src/state/*`, `src/utils/bills.ts`, `src/utils/cashForecast.ts`, `src/utils/alerts.ts`, `src/utils/invoices.ts`, `src/utils/whatIfForecast.ts`, `src/types.ts`, and all existing test files. No ID generators or reducers change.

## Decisions for you

1. **Seed data:** I plan to change only names and descriptions in `seed.ts`, keeping every amount and date. Do you want the amounts adjusted too? That would change computed forecast figures and may break existing assertions.
2. **`package.json` / `package-lock.json`:** commit them with Slice 7, or keep them out?

## Verification after the edit

- `npm test` must stay at 89/89 plus the new format tests.
- `npm run build` must pass.
- A tester pass to confirm the rendered output on each screen.

Nothing will be committed until you review the completed work. Reply with approval, and answer the three decisions above, to start the edits.
